== Published English Original Virtual Set 6 wording ==
The remaster limits the Used mode to one bounty hunter, and both retain two additional moves and free movement if escorting Han. The Lost mode now names the just-drawn qualifying weapon or Carbon-Freezing destiny. The later title has a printed dot that the 2004 slips and the [[:File:CC-D-hesallyoursbountyhunter-decipher-archive.gif|Decipher base]] lack.
